title: Contradictory security closure claims
basis: Review says tests not yet run and also closed/proven
closure_requirement: Relabel pending validation; execute pre-fix failure/post-fix pass and independent review

title: Privilege and tenant-boundary hardening
basis: Critical staff self-escalation and high profile/tenant findings described
closure_requirement: Verify migration/configuration and scoped negative tests; no real records before staging gate

title: Isolation coverage incomplete
basis: Database policy evidence alone cannot prove all interfaces
closure_requirement: Test APIs, storage, exports, caches, search, jobs and privileged workers

title: Official-record authority
basis: Handoff and privacy draft keep institution/SIS authoritative
closure_requirement: Retain boundary; revise applicable contracts and authorize any future native domain transfer

title: Notification timing conflict
basis: 24-hour readiness target versus bracketed 72-hour confirmation term
closure_requirement: Counsel/institution approve trigger, timing, recipients and incident procedure

title: Recovery targets unverified
basis: Proposed RPO/RTO without supplied drill evidence
closure_requirement: Business-impact approval and measured isolated restore/reconciliation

title: Supplier security assertions
basis: US hosting/encryption/inherited reports require scoped proof
closure_requirement: Verify actual regions, flows, contract, configuration and supplier evidence

title: AI pattern scan limitations
basis: Pattern cases cannot establish all data egress prevention
closure_requirement: Classify all surfaces and inspect serialized outbound transport with synthetic canaries

title: Privacy contract placeholders
basis: Unsigned attorney-review template with role assertions and bracketed periods
closure_requirement: Qualified review, applicable jurisdictions, signed terms and institutional directions

title: De-identification retention
closure_requirement: Approve purpose, risk assessment, access, cohort protection and retention

title: Audit integrity evidence
basis: Append-only and actor-binding described at design level
closure_requirement: Prove actor binding, privileges, tamper detection and controlled export/lifecycle

title: Procurement and exercise evidence
basis: Vendor, accessibility, incident and insurance readiness remains evidence-dependent
closure_requirement: Collect scoped current evidence and relevant drills/reviews without treating plans as done
